questions.prompt: Which requests in a Claude batch are billed?

options.text: Every request, because the batch itself was submitted and used up all the capacity
options.explanation: Claude says errored, canceled and expired requests are not billed.

options.text: Only the ones that succeeded, since the other states are not billed at all
options.explanation: Right. Claude says errored, canceled and expired requests are not billed.

options.text: Only the first results to come back, since the later ones are free
options.explanation: Billing depends on the state of each request, not on when its result arrives.

questions.prompt: How long are Claude batch results available?

options.text: For 24 hours, the same as the batch window
options.explanation: The 24 hours is the window for processing, not for keeping results.

options.text: For ever, while the workspace is open
options.explanation: Claude says results are not kept for ever. Download them.

options.text: For 29 days after the batch was created
options.explanation: Right. Claude says batch results are available for 29 days after creation.

questions.prompt: What does OpenAI say about the models used in one Batch API input file?

options.text: Each input file may only include requests that use one single model
options.explanation: Right. OpenAI says each input file can only include requests to a single model.

options.text: A file can mix any models, as long as every request has its own id
options.explanation: OpenAI says one model per file. Ids do not change that.

options.text: A file can hold two models, one for each endpoint that appears in it
options.explanation: OpenAI says one model per input file.
